title: Puffco Pivot Glass Adapter
description:
The Glass Adapter makes it easy to add 3D Chamber tech to your favourite glass rig or bong. Simply twist the Adapter onto the Pivot base, insert the glass joint into your piece, and enjoy better flavour and bigger vapour with less hassle.

Includes a quick-release 3D Chamber and 10mm + 14mm glass joints.

Product Features:
– Compatible with multiple joint sizes

What’s Included:
1 x Pivot Glass Adapter
